name: All of Egypt
biome: Desert, Nile valley and delta agriculture, coastal and Sinai landscapes
description: Sum of the five analytical regions. Vegetation-fire candidates from MODIS and VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21), 2023-2025.

name: Sinai & Gulf of Suez
biome: Analytical bin of Egypt (not an administrative boundary)
description: East of the Suez Canal and north of 27.6N: the Sinai peninsula and the Gulf of Suez coast.

name: Nile Delta & Greater Cairo
biome: Analytical bin of Egypt (not an administrative boundary)
description: North of 29.8N between 29.5E and the Suez Canal: the Delta, Greater Cairo and the Canal cities.

name: Mediterranean West Coast
biome: Analytical bin of Egypt (not an administrative boundary)
description: North of 29.8N and west of 29.5E: Alexandria hinterland, the north-west coast and the western desert edge.

name: Middle Egypt & Central Desert
biome: Analytical bin of Egypt (not an administrative boundary)
description: Between 27.0N and 29.8N: Fayoum, Beni Suef, Minya, the oases and the central Eastern Desert.

name: Upper Egypt & Southern Desert
biome: Analytical bin of Egypt (not an administrative boundary)
description: South of 27.0N: Assiut to Aswan, the Red Sea coast and the southern deserts.
